title: ISRUC-Sleep: A comprehensive public dataset for sleep researchers.
description: ISRUC-Sleep is a public collection of overnight polysomnographic recordings with manual sleep stage annotations, organized into three subgroups that include healthy subjects, patients with sleep disorders, and multiple-night recordings. Signals include EEG, EOG, EMG and respiratory channels. Each recording was scored in 30-second epochs by two expert scorers. The dataset supports research on automatic sleep staging and sleep-disordered breathing, and has been converted to BIDS.
methods_description: Participants slept overnight in a clinical environment with a standard PSG montage. Two independent human scorers labeled each 30-second epoch as W, N1, N2, N3 or REM following AASM/R&K guidelines. Original .rec files were exposed as EDF without modification, and the annotations were added as events with 30 s duration.
